reviews.text:
The bird boarding service from MVZ Mariana was disappointing. I left my cockatiel with her for a week, and she returned it with the cage full of droppings—literally, even the inside of the cage was covered in them. I don't know what she fed it (apparently not the food I left), but it seems my cockatiel had diarrhea, judging by the state of the perches. To top it all off, she broke an entire jar of seeds I had left for her, which she didn't replace, didn't notify me about, and didn't deduct from the service fee until the day I picked up my bird. As far as I'm concerned, she either stole it or used it on her other birds.

Edit: A few days after I wrote this review, veterinarian Mariana del Toro contacted me to harass me via WhatsApp. It turns out the hospital sent her the review, and in her anger, she wrote to me, NOT to apologize for the cage being full of poop the last day (or maybe the whole week), or for breaking the food jar and the lack of communication about it, but to scold me and tell me how outraged she was after I said the bird stole the food. She ended by mentioning that the hospital and she would deny the bird any further care or boarding services from now on, as if that made me want to take him there again. Just so you know the professionals you're choosing to care for your pets.

I had different expectations of this hospital, and it was very disappointing and frustrating. I was extremely upset by what happened. I want to clarify that what I'm about to say happened some time ago, and I acted politely when I expressed my dissatisfaction and requested at least a partial refund for the cost of my pet's botched surgery. She only suffered and showed no improvement; in fact, she worsened. After reflecting on it, I feel it's my duty to share my negative experience. I won't name names, but it was a doctor who never addressed me directly and only led me to believe they were discussing a refund with the accountant. It was nearly 50,000 pesos down the drain, not to mention the cost of gas and my dog's stress. It's not fair that they have incompetent doctors who take advantage of our concern for our pets so easily.
I went to a specialist appointment in internal medicine; except for the wait (I was turned away at reception), I received excellent care from Dr. Carlos Mario and the medical staff 🧑🏽‍⚕️ 🦮
Excellent group of professionals

I highly recommend them. I received the best care!! Excellent eye surgery. I have three dogs, and they've all been treated wonderfully. One of my dogs was hospitalized at another vet, and I wasn't seeing any results; I even thought she was going to die. But I brought her to this vet, and they treated her incredibly well! Now she's doing great!! Another dog had an eye injury and had to have emergency surgery, and now he's doing great too!! The price is fair, and they don't overcharge at all. I'm so grateful because they knew exactly what to do. They're highly trained, and the care is excellent. I recommend them 100%!

Highly recommended. From the incredibly friendly and empathetic receptionist to the excellent follow-up care from the doctor.

10/10

We arrived with our Chihuahua, "Niño," in critical condition, with both eyes severely damaged and at high risk of losing his sight. Dr. Francisco, Dr. Rodrigo, and the entire team at San Javier Veterinary Hospital did what seemed almost impossible: through specialized surgeries, they managed to save his corneas and preserve his vision, despite the severe damage.

In one of the most difficult moments for our family, they gave us back hope.

Thank you for saving his eyes, but above all, for giving him back the opportunity to see life. Against all odds, today "Niño" can see again. ❤️🐾

Infinite thanks, Dr. Francisco, Dr. Rodrigo, and the entire team, for everything you have done for our little one. When we thought "Niño" had no hope of ever seeing again, you made the impossible possible.

You didn't just save his sight; you gave us back our Niño. ❤️

Excellent veterinary hospital. My little one couldn't have been in better hands. From the reception area, to the initial care provided by Dr. Héctor and the ophthalmology specialist, Dr. Francisco Benavides, all the staff have been very kind. The best service via WhatsApp, always answering my questions and keeping me updated on my pet's condition. I highly recommend them.

San Javier Review:
My dog ​​is 15 years old. He had cataracts, and I decided to take him to San Javier Hospital to improve his quality of life since he was constantly bumping into things at home.
I was worried he wouldn't tolerate the anesthesia, but the very empathetic anesthesiologist explained that they would use inhaled anesthesia to make it less harsh for my pet.
If I could change anything, it would only be that I had decided to operate sooner. Due to a misdiagnosis of heart problems, we waited 30 days, and the cataract in his left eye could no longer be operated on. He had to be injected to prevent further complications.
I tried to find a more affordable cardiologist, but the results he gave weren't accurate, and I ended up spending twice as much, finally going to the cardiologist Dr. Javier works with.

The second opinion was that my dog ​​was in normal condition for his age and that he was a candidate for surgery.

I wish Dr. Javier had been more specific about why he preferred working with a particular cardiologist for faster decision-making.
In the end, the entire procedure—hospitalization, anesthesia, and surgery—was a complete success.
I also want to mention that Dr. Javier is a very altruistic doctor and very mindful of the costs of procedures. If he can offer support in any way, he won't hesitate, as his passion is helping pets have a better quality of life.
I'm happy to share that my dog's quality of life has improved somewhat, but he still has some issues because only one eye could be operated on, and even then, his vision couldn't be corrected because the cataract and lens had to be removed.

I hope this review helps you make the best decision for your pet. Treating your pet's illness or condition is an investment in your best friend, and they will thank you for it forever.
Excellent service, Dr. Leslie Lopez is the best 💜 She provides great care and is very professional.
We've been there twice for emergencies and everything has been great. The night doctors were very kind.

My experience at San Javier Veterinary Hospital was very disappointing. I went expecting professional, transparent care focused on my dog's well-being; however, I encountered situations that left me dissatisfied.

One of the main problems was the consultation fee. I requested that the cost of a follow-up consultation be honored, but they told me that, since three months had passed since the previous consultation, it could no longer be considered as such. I disagreed with this reasoning, especially since the treatment my dog ​​had received had not yielded the expected results. I believe that when a patient continues to have the same health problem, there should be greater flexibility and a clear explanation of the follow-up policies and costs.

What worries me most is that, after the eye surgery performed on my dog, his condition remained practically unchanged. As an owner, it is frustrating to see that, after subjecting a pet to a procedure and incurring the corresponding expenses, there is no evident improvement or any response that inspires confidence regarding the follow-up of the case.

I understand that no treatment can guarantee results, but I do expect transparency, clear communication, and fair treatment. Unfortunately, my experience did not meet those expectations. I am sharing this opinion so that other pet owners can make an informed decision and so that the hospital can consider improving both the medical care and the treatment of its patients and their families.
We went to the emergency room and there were no doctors, there was NO EMERGENCY SERVICE

The cat vet is good and treats us well. However, we recently had to go during emergency hours and they don't have a vet on call, even though it's supposed to be a veterinary hospital. The staff themselves told us to go somewhere else.
Very professional service, they treated my pet very well
Excellent treatment of my dog

I want to start by saying that the veterinarian who previously treated one of my dogs is excellent: very professional, attentive, and dedicated. He even performed an ultrasound and explained each of her organs to me in detail. However, the experience I had on Friday, June 26th, was completely different and very disappointing.

That day, my dog ​​started choking right after a walk. She was coughing up thick, white foam and making very loud noises as she tried to breathe. I checked her throat and found nothing, so I thought it might be poisoning or some other serious emergency.

I rushed to the nearest veterinarian to my house, which is this clinic. I arrived with my dog ​​still choking and coughing up foam, but the receptionist didn't even look at her. She simply told me there were no appointments available and that they couldn't see us.

I explained that it was an emergency and that I didn't know if I would be able to get to another clinic in time. Even so, with all the calm in the world, she began asking for my information and looking up my phone number in the system. Since I couldn't find him, he wanted me to go through the entire registration process again and wait for a veterinarian to finish a routine consultation. At no point did he show any interest in assessing the seriousness of the situation; he didn't even look me in the eye.

I begged him to understand that it was an emergency, but he continued searching for my information on the computer without doing anything at all to help.

I had to rush to another veterinary clinic, where they did understand the seriousness of the case and attended to my dog ​​immediately, as is proper in a true emergency.

It's a shame that a clinic with good veterinarians has someone like that at reception. The lack of empathy, sensitivity, and judgment in recognizing an emergency is unacceptable. After this experience, I will definitely not be returning.

I took my dog ​​to the emergency vet because he was bleeding, had a lack of appetite, and was very lethargic. He had already been seen by another veterinarian that morning, so at San Javier Emergency Clinic they only examined him again and made some changes to his treatment.

The next day, after not receiving a timely response from the doctor and given my dog's condition, I had to take him to another hospital for emergency care. To my surprise, they then denied me service simply because I had sought medical attention elsewhere.

I find it very concerning that, in a situation where the priority should be the health and well-being of a living being, personal matters or professional ego take precedence. Medical care should be focused on the patient, especially in an emergency.

I went to the vet to take my cat for a checkup, and Doctors Carlos Mario, Olivia, and Andrea were very kind. When they examined my kitten, they treated her with so much love and respect, which made me feel very comfortable and safe ❤️. When they prescribed her medication, it came with a convenient cutting board, which was very helpful for knowing the correct dosage. I highly recommend this place for your pets!

I went to the vet because my dog ​​needed a checkup with a specialist dentist. The doctor said he required surgery. I had pre-operative tests done for my pet, and when I sent the results to the hospital's contact person, it took them two days to respond. I asked if I could contact the doctor directly if I went ahead with the surgery, and they said no. This is definitely not the level of response I expect from what calls itself a hospital. If something gets complicated after the surgery, would they really have to wait almost two days to respond?

The facilities look nice, and the doctor's attitude during the initial consultation was good.

We had a bad experience at this place. The customer service representative scheduled us incorrectly, they don't have enough operating rooms, and luckily we managed to prevent our dog from having surgery there. My recommendation is that they improve their customer service and treat their patients with more compassion.

Without a doubt, the best veterinarians I've ever entrusted with my dog ​​Luna's health.
Lunita came to San Javier Hospital on the recommendation of veterinarians in Tepic, Nayarit. They lacked the equipment and expertise to handle such a complex diagnosis. Luna was suffering from the effects of previous failed surgeries on both eyes, as well as a complication from immune-mediated thrombocytopenia, which was diagnosed there by the internist who took on the case after several specific tests. From the moment we arrived, they were 100% attentive to my Luna. We were given the correct information, and we had to make the decision to hospitalize her because her case was so complex that she needed to receive medication every hour in her eyes and intravenously to stabilize her so she could undergo surgery again. Today, thanks to that care and successful surgeries on both eyes, Luna can see and enjoy her days. Of course, she still needs care and medication, but now it's every 24 to 48 hours. Luna is a great case of comprehensive diagnosis, and today she lives happily, watching birds every day from her balcony and barking at everything that passes by. I am very grateful to all the veterinarians who were looking after her day and night, Dr. Francisco, Dr. Paloma, Dr. Carlos Mario, and all those who had those intense shifts caring for her. Thank you for continuing to look after her today, both in person when we go to her follow-up appointments and remotely every time we send messages, photos, and calls to keep Luna stable.
Friendly attention, careful supervision of hospitalized pets, detailed clinical study results and aftercare ☆☆☆
The care provided by the veterinarian Mariana del Toro was excellent.

It's a great veterinary hospital. They have the best specialists, especially in ophthalmology. My dog ​​had cataract surgery there, and the doctors provided excellent care and professionalism. She was recently hospitalized, and my dog ​​was very pampered during her stay. Thank you to the whole team for your dedication and love for animals 🐾.
Terrible service! It's like an IMSS clinic; if you don't bring your pet in dying, they won't treat you on Sundays, even though it's supposed to be a 24-hour hospital.

Dr. Andrea is an angel. She treated my kitten efficiently. We went in for an emergency appointment last night, and she followed all the procedures to give a good diagnosis (blood tests, ultrasound, examination). My cat was practically a zombie yesterday, but this morning he woke up full of energy and eager to eat. I highly recommend her.

It was a terrible post-visit experience; the person who answers WhatsApp messages doesn't have the brainpower to communicate what is being asked to the doctor, until after 3 days of asking for a response they finally reply when it is no longer necessary.
The service was very good.

Excellent care in the ophthalmology and ophthalmic surgery departments, particularly for glaucoma and valve placement to prevent eye rupture or retinal damage, especially from Dr. Paloma and Dr. Francisco.
Excellent service, only the waiting time is a bit long.

Excellent care!
I highly recommend Dr. Irving Posada. His diagnosis was very accurate, and we saw excellent results from the first week of treatment.

It was excellent service. 💯👌🏻
They are very attentive and careful with the animals.
I sincerely appreciate their support and dedication. 🐕‍🦺 …

Damn... I'm appalled by the level of negative comments about this place, all focused on the rudeness of the reception staff and how they deny emergency care, even going so far as to mention protocols and appointments for emergencies—absurd... I was planning to take my old dog there, but I'd better not. Thanks

The doctors who treated me were very kind and professional. Dr. Diego was incredibly attentive, dedicated, and professional.

However, the reception staff leaves much to be desired. From the moment you arrive, they answer rudely and make faces. No matter how politely I speak to them, they respond horribly. I made an appointment and waited a little over an hour. I waited patiently, and I understand they have a lot of work, but they never approached me to explain why I had to wait. If I hadn't gone back to ask, they probably would have left me there all day. I asked politely, and the young man at reception answered me in a very rude manner and asked me my pet's name again. I honestly don't mind waiting; I understand that happens, but what a terrible way to treat and greet you from reception.

Excellent service.

Arrive early to find parking.

The receptionists are incredibly arrogant and refuse to give you an appointment; they act like they're doing you a favor by seeing you. I've had some good doctors, but I've only been "lucky" twice. They need to change their customer service if they don't want to keep losing patients...

I didn't post this review earlier because I needed time to emotionally process what happened.

I took my 17-year-old dog, Blacky, to San Javier Veterinary Hospital for a routine checkup. He was an older dog, but functional, with a good appetite and a normal life. Just weeks before, he had even walked energetically around the hospital during his examination.

After the appointment, he was prescribed gabapentin, a strong medication, without any prior basic tests to assess his overall health. Days later, I began to notice a progressive decline: loss of appetite, weakness, and lack of energy.

Urine tests were ordered, but there was no timely follow-up. After insisting for several days, we went to the hospital in person, and that's when we were informed that the requested test hadn't been performed correctly: a bacterial culture had been done instead of a urinalysis, without anyone notifying us of the error so we could repeat the test in time.

When his kidney function was finally evaluated properly, the diagnosis was end-stage renal failure. Blacky died in my arms the following morning.

Additionally, I find it unethical that the hospital increases the cost of cremation services by approximately $1,000 MXN simply for acting as an intermediary with the provider, in addition to charging an extra consultation fee in euthanasia cases.

Other veterinary hospitals in the city offer these services without surcharges or unnecessary paperwork, understanding the sensitive nature of the situation.

I share this review respectfully, but with concern regarding the lack of follow-up, errors in clinical procedures, poor communication, and billing policies. Especially with geriatric patients, prior testing and responsible follow-up can make a crucial difference.
Empathetic and professional service

If there were more stars, I'd give them many more.
Never in my life with dogs (more than 20 of them!) have I received such professional, humane, and knowledgeable treatment as at this veterinary clinic.
They not only demonstrate exceptional experience and expertise, but also a warmth and empathy that are felt from the very first moment.
Dr. Leslie is an angel; her vocation and love for animals shine through in every consultation.
Without a doubt, the best veterinary care.

It's a comprehensive clinic, and the care is always provided by professionals. In my case, I was seen by Dr. Irving, who was always very patient and helpful with any questions. I definitely recommend them.

I arrived Sunday night for an emergency with my dog, who had swallowed a sock, and they attended to him immediately and very professionally. They explained the options and next steps, and on Monday I took him back for his follow-up appointment, having fasted. They gave me several options and the pros and cons of each. All the staff were very attentive, and they have good facilities and equipment.

My pet Bobby spent his last days with them. They were very considerate and thoughtful, returning his ashes to me in less than a week. And the care from their doctor, Diego, was excellent.

My current pet, Arya, arrived as an emergency case due to a botched surgery during a campaign. From the very first moment, they focused on improving her condition, providing me with detailed information about her needs. After a week under their care, my dog ​​is doing well and is happy at home. She loves going to the vet, and Dr. Andrea kept us informed every step of the way.

Everyone is incredibly kind. We went to see the neurologist, and he was a great help in understanding my dog's condition. They all treat everyone with exceptional kindness and genuine concern for the dogs' well-being. You can tell they're very compassionate people.
The best place to entrust your pets' health. Highly trained and dedicated staff.
The staff showed a lack of empathy; I'm not talking about the doctors, but the lack of follow-up and attention from what I suspect are the administrative or reception assistants.

We came here on the recommendation of our dogs' veterinarian. The first appointment was with an ophthalmologist, and he had a follow-up neurological consultation.

Both doctors were excellent in their approach, patient, and helpful in explaining our dog's condition.

The facilities are very clean, and the prices are reasonable considering they are specialists.

What stood out most was the veterinarians' care. They told us we could use human medications to save money and didn't order any unnecessary tests just to charge us. 10 out of 10
Excellent service for my Nymph 🫶🏼 …
Excellent service from the veterinarians, professional and caring with the animals. Thank you for saving my dog!

I had a terrible experience at this place. From the moment I arrived, the staff was in a bad mood and showed very little tact towards the pets and their owners. They asked me to have some blood tests done on my dog ​​and told me to contact them once I had the results so they could follow up. When I had the results ready, I first called to ask how to get them to me, whether those tests were sufficient or if more were needed before sedation, and I also mentioned that I had many questions about the results. I asked if there was any way Dr. Janet Alejandra (who had given me the initial consultation) or another doctor could see me. They told me it wasn't possible, that I should send the results via WhatsApp along with my questions, and they would get back to me later. I did this repeatedly, and they NEVER followed up. I went to another veterinary clinic instead.

We took our two dogs to a dental appointment at 8:00 a.m. with a pick-up time between 3:30 and 4:00 p.m. They arrived on time, but went into the procedure much later than scheduled: one at 1:14 p.m. and the other at 2:42 p.m. It was clear they wouldn't be fully recovered from the anesthesia by the time we were supposed to pick them up.

One of them finished her procedure at 4:06 p.m., so it didn't make sense that she would be fully awake and stable at 5:00 p.m. Even so, from that time on, they started calling us insistently to come get them. We explained that we had organized our day according to the original schedule, and that the delay was their responsibility.

Finally, we arrived at 6:00 p.m. When we picked them up, they charged us an additional 80 pesos, claiming the medications weren't included in the 12,500 peso estimate, which had never happened before at that same clinic. This made us think they were actually charging us for the extra hour the dogs were there because of their own delay.

When we got home, one of our dogs was in very bad shape, crying and in a lot of pain, even though they had supposedly already given her medication. We tried to contact the vet by text message, but we didn't get a response. When we called, they told us they couldn't give her anything else for the pain. The dog continued to suffer and also had an injured paw, apparently from the IV.
Good treatment, good doctors

Crosby the pigeon received a more comprehensive eye exam than I usually receive. The diagnosis confirmed what her Vet told me, and the medication was available through the clinic. Jackie was great. She answered my questions and answered questions that I didn't think to ask. So happy to add them to Crosby's list of Top Docs!
Thank you for saving my little one after he was bitten; from the beginning you gave us certainty about his eyelid and eye.
Poor service from reception staff, the costs are high and should be proportional to the service they offer.
Thank you for attending to my pet's emergency, everything turned out well.

A terrible experience and a complete lack of empathy from the administrative staff.
I scheduled and paid in advance for a very important test for my cat, who only has one kidney, to rule out a kidney stone. It was a delicate and urgent appointment, and yet the receptionists didn't register it.
This isn't the first time something like this has happened, and frankly, it's unacceptable.
It's not just a mistake: they're playing with the time and health of pets, who often arrive in critical condition and need immediate attention.
The lack of organization, communication, and responsibility from the administrative area generates total distrust.

I want to clarify that it's not the doctors' fault, because there are highly qualified professionals with a true vocation, like Dr. Irving, who has always been attentive and careful with my pets. But it's infuriating to see how good medical work is overshadowed by the incompetence of the reception staff. Honestly, if you want responsible and professional care, seek treatment directly from Dr. Irving at another office, where they truly value their clients' time, health, and trust.
I wish I could give them zero stars.
